<function name="AutoMovement" parent="NPC" type="classfunc">
	<description>Executes any movement the current sequence may have.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<added>2021.03.31</added>
	<args>
		<arg name="interval" type="number">This is a good place to use <page>Entity:GetAnimTimeInterval</page>.</arg>
		<arg name="target" type="Entity" default="NULL"></arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">`true` if any movement was performed.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
